memory_bridge: Use one departure door to contrast agency: 出る is the passenger going out, while 出す is the passenger putting a suitcase out. Above both, 出発 names the departure itself with canonical シュツ, compressed to しゅっ in しゅっぱつ.

anchors.phonological_note: 促音化 shortens シュツ to しゅっ before 発.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 出発（しゅっぱつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The 出発（しゅっぱつ） board flashes over the exit. Canonical シュツ compresses to しゅっ before 発, so the visible word teaches both the reading and its common surface form.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 出る（でる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The passenger personally crosses the threshold and 出る（でる）—leaves. No object is moved; the person goes out.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 出す（だす）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The passenger reaches back and 出す（だす） the suitcase—takes it out. Here someone moves an object through the same door.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 小心 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: 小心: a monitor draws one steady high line over the heart while you stay careful; hold xīn high and level.
